name: io.github.ayers-software-repair/lancelot
description: An MCP server for search and retrieval over a local LanceDB database
title: Lancelot

environmentVariables.name: LANCEDB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Folder that holds the LanceDB database. It must exist; Lancelot only reads it.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Enables vector search by sending query text to OpenAI to compute embeddings. Without it, search is text only and nothing leaves the machine.
